title: Gold Years Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document lists eligibility and account terms for a “Gold Years” account: must be at least 62 years old; $0 monthly maintenance fee; 1.0% APY; $3.50 foreign ATM withdrawal fee (waived if balance is $10,000+ at withdrawal time, though third-party ATM fees may apply). It also specifies $5,000 daily debit purchase and $600 daily ATM withdrawal limits, plus required application verification (DOB confirmation and valid government-issued ID).
